aññāṇacariyā.p: [Aññāṇa+cariyā] (thī) Google Translate Ignorance is caused by delusion. Ignorance: The Dhamma of lust caused by delusion. The Dhamma of lust that arises in the unknowable senses in the true sense of the word. Ignorance is the only thing that can happen.
